long_description.before:
The goal of Vantedge AI, formerly known as 8vdx, is to provide an Agent Marketplace of curated agents to enable investors to get an investing edge to generate alpha by leveraging AI. Our insight to build this marketplace comes from our experience from running a credit hedge fund for 15 years and as a Y Combinator backed startup, we understand the complexities of AI and are here to offer a complete infrastructure to funds and startups alike.
Our platform is built to serve the investment community with the highest security, compliance, and infrastructure tailored for institutional investors.
long_description.after: FundOS is the agentic operating system for fund managers. It replaces the manual "human glue" between a fund's systems with audit-logged AI agents — covenant monitoring, capital calls, diligence, recon, and reporting — running on the data funds already have, via MCP, with no migration. Dogfooded at Eight Capital, where FundOS runs a 270+ company YC portfolio off a single spine of data, auto-generating NAVs and K-1s. Clients include Semper Capital (London) and a New York asset manager. SOC 2, role-based access, LP-scoped data, and a full audit trail. Built by a team that ran a credit fund for 15 years.

one_liner.after: FundOS — AI operations for fund managers

long_description.before: Cleva enables African freelancers and businesses to receive international payment for their service, while protecting themselves from local currency volatility. With a Cleva USD account, one can easily receive USD payment from anywhere in the world, spend via a card, pay bills, convert to local currency, and save in USD to hedge against local currency volatility.
long_description.after:
Cleva breaks down financial borders across the globe by enabling remote workers, individuals, and businesses to hold stablecoin-backed dollars. Specifically, we enable our customers:

1. Receive USD, GBP, EUR payments: Individuals and businesses can receive USD, GBP, and EUR payments into their virtual account.
2. Receive and send stablecoins: They can also receive USDT or USDC, and make global payments via USDT and USDC.
3. Hold funds in USD: They can choose to hold their funds in USD instead of converting to local currency. In high inflation countries, this is extremely desirable as it helps our customers hedge against inflation until they're ready to spend in local currency.
4. Stablecoin-backed cards: We issue cards that are stablecoin-backed and accepted by 150M+ merchants across the globe. Users can fund in stablecoins or fiat, spend anywhere VISA is accepted, and earn cashback in the form of Cleva Points.
5. Savings: We recently launched Cleva Pots, allowing users to save towards their goals and earn yield on their savings.

It's still very early days at Cleva. We've been hyper-focused on our home country Nigeria but we're now expanding to more countries across the globe.

long_description.before:
What if you could train a biological foundation model on... the entire internet?

Exonic is pioneering a new generation of biological foundation models, focused on heterogeneous, unstructured, and noisy datasets.

Our first application is the design of safer gene therapies.

In 2025, we used AI to set a new state of the art in liver cancer targeted gene therapy, validated in vitro in our lab in San Francisco.

So far in 2026, we have trained a new model with unprecedented zero-shot generalization on genomic regulatory expression in hold-out biosample datasets. More to be shared soon.
long_description.after: We program DNA sequences to be context-aware, unlocking new kinds of genetic therapies.

one_liner.after: Exonic is an AI-native cell and gene therapeutics company.

long_description.before: Risklytics is a commercial insurance brokerage for frontier tech: robotics, autonomy, data centers, and energy infrastructure. Insurers are writing AI exclusions into standard liability forms, so companies whose products act in the physical world end up holding risk they thought they had transferred. We specialize in that gap, and we know which carriers in the admitted and surplus lines markets will still underwrite it. If you're building anything that moves, lifts, drives, or powers something, we'd like to talk.
long_description.after: Risklytics is the insurance company for frontier tech such as physical AI, robotics, and data centers. Companies answer 6 questions and we bind a tailored policy that other insurance companies won’t.

long_description.before:
Moving Atoms is frontier robotics lab. Our goal is to solve robotics, then solve abundance.

Our first model, Atom 1, pre-trained on the internets video, and fine tuned for physics, already tops the Physics IQ benchmark.

By using this model, we can significantly reduce the amount of robot data we need to collect to build our robot model (a world action model).

Our second core bet is to design our robot model to be micromanaged by LLMs, allow robotics to use the orchestration and planning abilities of LLMs while having the physics, contact and timing be controlled by the robot model (world action model).
long_description.after:
Our first model, Atom 1, pre-trained on the internets video, and fine tuned for physics, already tops the Physics IQ benchmark.
It has been action conditioned, so you can simulate robot actions within it.
This lets Robot Labs check every checkpoint, getting you results in minutes; instead of having to wait days for human evaluations. 
It also lets you simulate unseen and hard to replicate environments.

A world model good enough to grade robots is a world model good enough to drive one!
Our second core bet is to design our robot model (world action model) to be micromanaged by LLMs, allow robotics to use the orchestration and planning abilities of LLMs while having the physics, contact and timing be controlled by the robot model (world action model).

one_liner.after: World models that train and test robots in sim, #1 on Physics-IQ

long_description.before:
Audio-visual translation infrastructure for all video, live and recorded -- the first and only that works in real time. World translation: not just changing voice and lips into a new language, but understanding the scene, the sound, and preserving the human.

🦋 Movies & TV, Micro-dramas, Live Broadcasts, Live Shopping, Corporate & Education, Ads, Creators & Podcasts, Platforms. Day-and-date, in every territory.

Founders An Zhu Liu, Jibin Song, Mingi Kwon, and Xu Zheng lead a team of PhDs, professors, and researchers from the world's top universities who started the field of joint audio-visual human models and co-authored the current state of the art in real-time human animation. Since 2021: over 10,000 citations and 100+ papers at ICLR, NeurIPS, CVPR, ECCV, and more.

Translation has to be a world model. A translator has to know who's speaking: where every sound in the dense polyphony originates. Laughter here, a short yell there, a voice from off-screen, someone on screen mouthing words before being interrupted. Everyone else scaffolds separate models and pre-processing; a world model simulates the scene. It's a spatio-temporal reasoner: predicting continuity across frames forces it to internalize 3D geometry, spatial reasoning, and permanence -- of objects, people, and the environment itself. The scene state survives the edit: when the shot pans or cuts away, someone off-screen still exists, still owns their voice, and is still there when the camera comes back. Multiple people, side views, off angles, fast motion -- the hard cases hold.

Vs ElevenLabs: they lose the laughter, the music, the ambiance -- 270% more background-sound error -- and ours sounds 27.8% more like you. That means no recasting, no ADR, no M&E stems required -- it works from the final mix.

Vs human translators: 100.3% of their quality -- scalable, real time. Published benchmarks: https://thefamiliarlab.com/benchmark

long_description.before: Grip is a robotics company building intelligent robotic systems for waste and recycling. Its technology combines learning-based manipulation and custom hardware to identify and pick objects from messy, constantly changing waste streams. By learning from real-world operating data, including every successful and failed grasp, Grip’s systems become more reliable and adaptable over time. The goal is to help waste operators reduce difficult manual sorting, recover more valuable material, lower contamination, and deploy automation more flexibly across different facilities and waste streams. Ultimately, Grip is building the intelligent manipulation layer for waste infrastructure, making recycling and the circular economy more efficient and scalable.
long_description.after: Grip is a robotics company building intelligent robotic systems for waste and recycling. We are starting with organic waste, where removing contaminants from messy, constantly changing streams remains difficult and highly manual. Our technology combines learning-based manipulation and custom hardware to identify and pick objects, learning from real-world operating data, including every successful and failed grasp, to become more reliable and adaptable over time. This helps waste operators reduce manual sorting, recover more valuable material, lower contamination, and deploy automation flexibly across facilities. Over time, Grip aims to expand beyond organics and build the intelligent manipulation layer for trash in general, making waste processing and the circular economy more efficient and scalable.

long_description.before:
Locke builds AI agents that help companies and governments work together.

Our agents power Locke Government Affairs, the first AI-native government affairs firm, and are now being deployed to government agencies across America.

Every major company in America needs to work with government: AI labs, data centers, robotics, defense, the list goes on.

Locke is fixing the access and software bottlenecks that prevent that from happening.

Locke's team comes from The White House, Deloitte, the US Congress, and the Pentagon.
long_description.after:
Locke builds AI agents that help companies and governments work together.

Our agents power Locke Government Affairs, the first AI-native government affairs firm, and are being deployed to government agencies across America.

Every consequential American company in the 21st century will need to work with the government: AI labs, data centers, healthcare, defense, robotics, the list goes on. Locke is building the AI infrastructure to power the next era of public-private collaboration.

Locke's team comes from The White House, Deloitte, the US Congress, and the Pentagon.
